title: P15.10-C FINAL hotfix: cost halt TOCTOU — in-txn halt re-check on authoritative billing

FREE/SUBSCRIPTION/UNMETERED semantics unchanged; advisory pre-check kept. Finding A verdict held: SAFE_BY_EXISTING_PROOF_WITH_TWO_INCONCLUSIVE_TAMPER_EDGES (A2a wob.mission_id unverified, A3b >8-hop claim + missing leaf alloc -> manual; both need non-canonical row writes — hardening notes only, objectiveScopeFor unchanged).
